description: Tracks product-building and design tool repositories from GitHub signals.

items.description: Super Productivity is an advanced todo list app with integrated Timeboxing and time tracking capabilities. It also comes with integrations for Jira, GitLab, GitHub and Open Project.
A fully open source & end-to-end encrypted note taking alternative to Evernote.
Bringing Astrid Tasks back from the dead
Open-source Flutter habit tracker with smart scoring, WebDAV sync, local-first storage, privacy-focused design, and support for Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, and Linux.

NEO Emacs (WIP): GPU powered Emacs written in Rust with a modern display engine. Aiming for modern design & multi-threaded Elisp, 10x performance, zero-pause concurrent GC and 100% Emacs compatibility.
Plan, build and launch products with AI: guided planning prompts, an AI App Starter for Next.js, Supabase and Vercel, and agent configurations.

Laya is an open-source, local-first AI notification command center that aggregates Slack, Gmail, GitHub, Jira, Notion, Outlook,  Calendar (and more) notifications using local LLMs via Ollama and LM Studio. Supports cloud models via BYOK.
A free, open-source Stardock Fences alternative for Windows 11. Glass fences, live folders, tabs, Peek. Rust, ten languages, portable.
A lightweight, open-source Alfred-style launcher for Windows.

Free, sub-second on-device AI dictation for macOS. Dual engines (Whisper + Parakeet) on Apple Silicon. Optional AI polish on your Mac with EG-1 or S1-mini by Superwhisper, Apple Intelligence (macOS 26), Ollama, or your own OpenAI/Gemini/Claude key. Snippets, custom words, no account, no subscription, audio never leaves your Mac.
The ultimate open-source Android gesture & one-hand navigation suite. An all-in-one OHO+ (One Hand Operation+), FooView & Quick Cursor alternative with offline OCR and Shizuku.
Open-source workspace for professional document AI: reviewable agent edits, source-linked work, three-way document merges, and an extensible plugin runtime. Starting with legal work.
One AI agent, everywhere you work — terminal, desktop, mobile, and your chat apps. Rust core.
Cattr server application - self-hosted time tracking with project management, reports, screenshots, activity tracking and public API
A focus app that unlocks distracting apps only after solving adaptive math challenges.
